# Kontrol AI

> Kontrol AI is a Gold Coast AI workflow automation consultancy for Australian trade, field service and professional services businesses. It automates the admin between the work: job request emails turned into SimPRO jobs, supplier invoices checked against purchase orders, and live dashboards that show which jobs make money. Every automation is built on n8n around the systems a business already runs, quoted at a fixed price agreed before work starts, and owned outright by the client at handover. Founder Chris Olanda scopes and builds every project. Kontrol AI works across the Gold Coast, Brisbane and South East Queensland, and with clients nationally. Operated by CO Advisory Pty Ltd.

## Facts

- Name: Kontrol AI, also written Kontrolai.
- Legal entity: CO Advisory Pty Ltd, ABN 85 693 421 788.
- Based: Gold Coast, Queensland, Australia.
- Service area: on site across the Gold Coast, Brisbane, Logan, Redland, Ipswich and Tweed Heads. Clients elsewhere in Australia are served remotely.
- Founder: Chris Olanda, who scopes and builds every project.
- Contact: ai@kontrolai.com.au
- Website: kontrolai.com.au. The domain kontrolai.com is not connected to Kontrol AI.
- Platform: n8n. The client owns the workflows and their documentation at handover.
- Price: automation builds from A$2,200 ex GST, with a fixed price for each build agreed in writing after a scoping conversation. Live dashboards run as a monthly service.
- Timeframes: the first workflow is usually live within 2 to 3 weeks of a signed scope. Dashboards are usually live within a week.
- Evidence: the home page publishes automation runs, jobs automated end to end, duplicate jobs stopped and admin hours removed, refreshed daily from live client pipeline data.
- Facts last updated: 30 October 2026.

## Services

- [Automation builds](https://kontrolai.com.au/services.html): custom n8n automations around the systems a business already runs, such as SimPRO and the inbox. Fixed quote after scoping, from A$2,200 ex GST.
- [Live dashboards](https://kontrolai.com.au/custom-business-dashboards.html): operational dashboards built from job management and accounting data, usually live within a week, run as a monthly service.
